profile_text.body:
OpenAI is a for-profit AI company founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its primary consumer product is ChatGPT, described on its website as a tool to answer questions, write, create images, complete work, and code, with a free tier and downloadable app available. The company also offers the OpenAI API and GPT models for developers on a usage-based pricing model, an API Playground and Dashboard for testing and fine-tuning, the DALL-E image generation system, the Sora video generation product, and the Whisper API for speech recognition, transcription, and translation. Operator, an autonomous web agent capable of browser control, rounds out the current product lineup.

OpenAI is party to a substantial number of active legal matters. Cases on record include copyright and data-related suits filed in the Northern District of California, the Southern District of New York, and elsewhere, among them wikiHow, Inc. v. OpenAI, Inc. and several individual plaintiff actions such as Byrd v. OpenAI, Inc. and Craddock v. OpenAI OpCo LLC. The Florida Attorney General's office has filed suit against OpenAI Global, LLC in the Southern District of Florida, and two separate federal matters styled United States v. OpenAI OpCo LLC are pending in the Eastern District of Arkansas. X.AI Corp. has an appeal proceeding against OpenAI before the Ninth Circuit.

The company also has a registered presence in the MCP server registry, with several third-party servers built around its APIs, covering image and audio generation as well as academic paper search and stock data retrieval.
